parts: [shouting] FUCK! [annoyed] Your punk ass reflection stopped fucking copying you.
[smug] Damn, bro. [mocking] You got fucking fat.
[pained] Then it kicks you right in the fucking nuts.
[frustrated] So you grab a goddamn hammer. [disbelief] Not a fucking scratch.
Sledgehammer. Chainsaw. [shouting] A fucking bomb! [exasperated] That bitch is fucking invincible.
[determined] So you sail across the whole goddamn Pacific to get away from that piece of shit.
[annoyed] But you're in the middle of the goddamn ocean. [shouting] Your reflection is FUCKING everywhere... [deflated] and it's laughing at you.
[mischievously] So you show the bastard a mirror. [laughs] And it can't stand its own fucking face.
[satisfied] Reflect on that, motherfucker. [excited] Hell yeah. Sweet!
